svg.title: FIG-29 implementation reference: one U575 MPU-v2 task / PC7 WRITE grant STM32U575ZIT6Q / TZEN0 / MSIS4 / CM33 NTZ / eight MPU regions Host models + normal M33 reset link; installed SDK recorded separately Runtime MPU / GPIO electrical / HIL not executed
svg.desc: Explicit normal memory generator / real reset startup Privileged Flash + syscall Flash + user Flash Privileged RAM + user RAM; unassigned tails not mapped to user User DATA copied / BSS zeroed only after all bounds pass; One protected user task No peripheral MMIO mapping; three scalar arguments nx_freertos_user_gpio_write(device, set, reset); Selected real veneer / SVC70 / 71-entry table Pinned CM33 NTZ origin + protected stack checks Existing delay6 / ticks13 remain separate; One strong immutable privileged-Flash binding Fixed grant -> readonly nx_binding_led slot -> actual face / ops Full extents checked before nested dereference Complete actual GPIO context in disjoint privileged RAM; Actual kernel current TCB Same static TCB / live task epoch No user-selected identity, registry or worker; Saved-mask final check through effect Open + live incarnation + device Disjoint set/reset; combined mask nonzero Only PC7 bits; no kernel call / wait / product callback; Real typed GPIO helper -> exact U575 provider One bounded BSRR write All helper / provider instructions must be privileged Flash; Scalar nx_result_t in R0 Accepted SVC: real protected exit Refused veneer: CONTEXT fallback No payload borrow or asynchronous request; Fail closed before GPIO effect Wrong task / device or bits outside grant: PERMISSION Malformed trusted binding: INVALID Both masks zero or overlapping: INVALID Closed / stale: STATE; bad context: CONTEXT; One privileged lifecycle owner Static task start -> open pins deletion All linked control / grant / provider storage stays live; close revokes admission; pin remains join excludes every scalar effect and removes pin Neither operation deletes task or resets task epoch; Pinned delete -> BUSY; self-delete rejected After join: closing marker -> real kernel delete -> clear handle Preserve task epoch; wrap rejects; Maintained selected static ELF proof Three user entries / real veneers / complete privileged extents Source-bound selected/default costs: evidence README M7 stays negative; no runtime isolation / electrical / HIL result; explicit user execute / XN data regions; protected code / readonly authority / private state; trusted assembly; no user pointer; open snapshots actual live incarnation; public scalar call; real dispatcher obtains current TCB before guard; validated fixed capability; check again under saved mask; only admitted WRITE; restore incoming masks / return result; any failed final check; invalid protected entry; no BSRR write; explicit close then join; same single-core exclusion boundary; successful join before deletion; new task incarnation; never reset epoch; software links are not physical qualification
